greeting: Kade on comms. Stage 3: The Council of Allies. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running The Progenitor's Will. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I saw gravity file for overtime in this sector. Management approved.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Hear Nix7's analysis.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Hear Nix7's analysis; Hear Skysong's wisdom; Hear Vesper's research. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Consult with all companions before making the final choice. Immediate move: Hear Nix7's analysis.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 3 resolved: The Council of Allies. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Choice Made.
rumor: Engine technicians heard the core whisper every companion name in order.
People keep repeating one clue from The Council of Allies: 'Hear Sovereign's leadership'.
I met my future self and we argued about shoe durability.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn in the palace refracts through crystal halls; false routes are common.
dialog.time_noon: Noon activates old systems and old defenses. Assume every tile is listening.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk makes memory projections bolder. Do not negotiate with every ghost.
dialog.time_night: Night at the engine core is quiet and dangerous. Keep your purpose fixed.

party_reactions.kade: Note to self: less speech, more action.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Kade accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Kade mode unlocked. We do the brave thing and then eat something huge.

relationship_dialog.stranger: No speeches. Give me actionable details.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You made it back. Report status.
relationship_dialog.friend: With you here, the odds stop looking stupid.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Same plan as always: adapt, push, survive, repeat.
